instruction_ref: CEO 2026-11-28: separate production and publication; remove repeated publishing QA except CEO/COO approval and data presence; no publication slots; independent image defect QA
instruction: Separate production and publication lanes using one existing LaunchAgent and the same durable jobs. Production daily target counts review-ready new articles, existing-article recovery remains uncapped. Publication independently processes approved PUBLISH_PENDING jobs without reservation or QA revalidation. Retain external publication stop controls, exact CEO/COO approval, required data, existing URL and technical release checks. New images receive independent actual-image QA at the Designer stage. No publication provenance veto.
implementer: BU-002 isolated Staging direct patch, no Codex development
preserved_rules: Existing pre-review product, content, claim, safety and machine QA remain; approved exact payload and evidence hashes must match
Global/manual and independent controller stop controls remain publication-only; no publication slot or count cap
Existing published article URL, exact approved revision, one durable job, existing protected GitHub/Pages release and postpublication read-back preserved
Existing new-topic stop, legacy recovery rules and other BU unaffected
Existing image generation routes and no paid API policy preserved; image QA uses existing Codex Reviewer settings
No fabricated QA or approval records; prior receipt retained for audit only
